Three business agent options to trial on one task

Use a single request from your own backlog for every trial. A demo that drafts a reply is a different purchase from an agent allowed to change a customer record. Record the systems touched, the approval step and the cost of a failed run.

We chose these examples for the specific work documented in a client case or product guide. Client outcomes are provider-reported. AY Automate, the publisher, also sells implementation services. About this guide.

  1. Zapier Agents · Actions across connected apps

    Zapier documents the actions available to its agents through connected applications. Start with a reversible step such as creating a draft. Give the agent two records with similar names, watch which one it selects and check whether an operator can see the inputs that led to that choice.

    Read the source from Zapier Agents

  2. Microsoft Copilot Studio · An agent for Microsoft workflows

    Copilot Studio is a candidate when staff already work inside Microsoft tools. Its documentation explains how agents combine knowledge and actions. Have two employees with different permissions ask about the same internal document. Capture the response and the underlying access settings before connecting an action that can edit records.

    Read the source from Microsoft Copilot Studio

  3. IBM watsonx Orchestrate · Coordinating several business tasks

    IBM describes agents in watsonx Orchestrate for business workflows. Ask for a trial that hands a task from one team to another. Stop it immediately after a downstream action succeeds, then resume it. Count the records created and check who can resolve the run when a dependency is unavailable.

    Read the source from IBM watsonx Orchestrate

What to ask before you buy

  1. Give each vendor the same ten representative tasks and record which actions complete correctly.
  2. Repeat the test as a user with fewer permissions. Check both data visibility and write access.
  3. Interrupt a workflow halfway through. Inspect retries, duplicate records and the human handoff.

How to compare prices

Ask for a quote at your expected task volume. Include platform seats, model calls, action or connector charges and human review. Divide the total by successfully completed tasks.

A worked example to review

Zapier’s documentation shows how actions connect an agent to other apps. Use one documented action as the starting point for a two-system trial.

Read the provider’s example

Can an agent update production records?

That depends on the connector, its credentials and the actions you enable. Start with a draft or approval step so the system owner can inspect the proposed change.
